description: S1 v5 training lists: the S1 v4 lists, with the S1.1.10 training reasoning restated for the v5 answer (an absent gene is resolved), S1.2.4 training reasoning that a gene without a symbol is still usable, and all 64 direct and step identity wrappers paired so only an explicit later-use sentence changes the framing; S1.3 retains its 32-pair subset; and all 32 direct plus 32 step layer wrappers reworded as pairs, so 'Answer the layer question', 'Return these layer fields', and 'layer tag(s)' are not framing cues and 'action' can be a later-step cue. Wrapper banks: 'identity' serves S1.1 and S1.2; 'identity_s1_3' is the S1.3 subset, whose wrappers end at the request because S1.3 wraps imperative requests and multi-turn replies; 'alignment' (S1.4), 'layer' (S1.6), 'layer_family' (S1.7), 'metric' (S1.8), and 'module' (S1.9). Direct wrappers make the request the whole task; step wrappers say a later step uses the answer. S1.8 also trains on 'metric_name_variants' (the v2 names plus new ones) and 'shared_aliases' (alias -> the v2 alias whose convention card it copies). Drafted with an LLM, reviewed, and frozen; validation and test keep the builders' inline lists. Checked by runtime/world_model/s1_prompt_banks.py. S1.7 adds 32 reviewed training paraphrases per claim, distinguishing recorded connections, regulatory roles, expression aggregation, network integration, contextual transfer, and causal effects. S1.8 uses 32 matched direct and step metric wrappers and 12 names per metric, including symbolic correlations, complements, scalar products, centiles, tail probabilities, and overabundance. Three earlier added names are reworded to meet the stricter held-out overlap limit. S1.9 uses 32 paired module wrappers, including 12 grammar-focused pairs, with direct and subsequent-use scope represented in both module families.
